summary:
The follow-up fixes preserve explicit zero and blank threshold semantics and make inventory mutations atomic and serialized with their activity records.
- Converts blank thresholds to five while preserving zero.
- Wraps category and item mutations with audit insertion in one transaction.
- Serializes transaction units and translates concurrent duplicate-category creation into a conflict.
- Adds transaction, RPC, and end-to-end regression coverage.
